# The Fool: challenge my plan (Jeffallan)

Stress-tests an idea or plan with five structured critical-reasoning modes.

- Source: https://github.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills/main/skills/the-fool/SKILL.md
- Author: Jeffallan
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/the-fool-challenge-my-plan-jeffallan-d0b2c56f

Claude restates your position in its strongest form, lets you pick how to challenge it, and then presents the 3 to 5 strongest objections before building a stronger version of the plan. The five modes are Socratic questioning of assumptions, arguing the other side, a pre-mortem of failure modes, red teaming, and testing whether the evidence supports the conclusion.

**Try asking:**
- "Play devil's advocate on our plan to move everything to microservices"
- "Run a pre-mortem on this product launch plan"
- "Red team this authentication design before we build it"

**Source:** [Jeffallan/claude-skills](https://github.com/Jeffallan/claude-skills/tree/HEAD/skills/the-fool) · MIT · by Jeffallan
